effect_definition: pollinator temperature slope minus plant temperature slope, days per degree C

rows.diagnostic_se_rule: sqrt(bee_SEM^2 + plant_SEM^2); groups are disjoint but this does not reconstruct interaction-level covariance
convert marginal 95% CIs of WMD slopes to approximate SEs, scale per 0.1 C to per C, then propagate under zero covariance
treat source table ±SD labels as if they were SE and assume zero cross-model covariance; intentionally invalid for inference and used only to stress-test sign/weight sensitivity
